description: This file defines the StringStorageInterface interface for Drupal's locale module, specifying methods for managing locale strings, translations, and related operations.

classes.name: StringStorageInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface for locale string storage operations in Drupal.

methods.name: getStrings
methods.description: Loads multiple source string objects based on conditions and options.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Loads multiple string translation objects based on conditions and options.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Loads string location information based on conditions.

methods.name: findString
methods.description: Fast query to load a string source object.

methods.name: findTranslation
methods.description: Fast query to load a string translation object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a string object to storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a string object from storage.

methods.name: deleteStrings
methods.description: Deletes source strings and translations using conditions.

methods.name: createString
methods.description: Creates a new source string object bound to this storage.

methods.name: createTranslation
methods.description: Creates a new string translation object bound to this storage.
